subject: Co-sponsor: Partner Lounge & Micro-Demo Track at ScaleAI Summit — logistics & content
messages:
From: Priya Rao <priya@nimbleops.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.inference>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>
Date: Sat, 12 Sep 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: ScaleAI Summit — partner lounge + micro-demo track (co-sponsor request)

Diego / Marissa,

Thanks again for the intro call last week — NimbleOps would love to explore co-sponsoring the Partner Lounge at ScaleAI Summit (Oct 20-22). The organizer (Liz Morales, cc'd) has a limited number of partner lounge slots and a new "micro-demo" track we think would be a great fit for a joint Redwood + NimbleOps session.

High-level from our side:
- Partner Lounge: shared footprint, tabletop for quick demos and 2 lounge seats for meetings (we propose rotating staffing).
- Micro-demo track: 10-12 minute rapid talks, 3-4 demos per block; we can co-curate a 30-min block highlighting a real customer using Redwood inference + NimbleOps orchestration.

Attachments: ScaleAI_Sponsor_Package.pdf (organizer's packet).

Questions for you:
1) Would Redwood be open to co-sponsoring (cost share) and providing a speaker for the demo block?
2) Who would own signups / lead capture (we can integrate HubSpot forms or share leads via CSV)?
3) Any branding / content constraints we should know about?

If this looks promising, Liz suggested a 30-min logistics sync with the three of us and the ScaleAI events team next week.

Best,
Priya Rao
Head of Alliances, NimbleOps
priya@nimbleops.com

--
Attachment: ScaleAI_Sponsor_Package.pdf (PDF, 1.8MB)

From: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.inference>
To: Priya Rao <priya@nimbleops.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.inference>
Date: Sat, 12 Sep 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ScaleAI Summit — partner lounge + micro-demo track (co-sponsor request)

Priya — thanks for the note and for looping Liz in. We're interested. Quick responses inline below and a few asks: 

1) Co-sponsor: yes — finance needs a high-level estimate but we can commit to a cost-share. I'll follow up with legal on a simple LOI, and Marissa will coordinate the budget sync.

2) Speaker: happy to nominate someone from our field team. Suggest Marissa run program coordination; Sergio can help on collateral and joint demo flow.

3) Leads / signups: we prefer HubSpot forms + Drift integration, but CSV handoff works if ScaleAI has restrictions. We also want to ensure opt-in language is compliant for EU attendees.

Logistics sync: available Tue 09/15 10:00-11:00 PT or Wed 09/16 13:00-14:00 PT. Either works for us.

Next steps (proposed):
- Marissa to draft a one-pager (audience, session title, speakers, ask). Due: 2026-09-18.
- Sergio to prepare a short demo plan & asset list. Due: 2026-09-20.
- Diego to submit LOI / cost-share request to finance.

I'll add a draft partner playbook as an attachment for your review.

Diego Fernandez
Director, Partnerships | Redwood Inference
diego@redwood.inference

--
Attachment: redwood-partner-playbook.docx (DOCX, 240KB)

From: Liz Morales <liz@scaleai.org>
To: Priya Rao <priya@nimbleops.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.inference>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>
Date: Sun, 13 Sep 2026 14:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ScaleAI Summit — partner lounge + micro-demo track (co-sponsor request)

Thanks, Priya and Diego — glad to have you both. A few clarifications from the organizer side:

- Micro-demo blocks are 30 minutes total: 3 x 10-minute demos. We'll give a 5-minute intro and a quick Q&A at the end.
- Booth footprint: 10'x10' partner lounge tabletop + shared seating. You can add a roll-up banner and one pop-up if space allows.
- Leads: we can run a shared QR that pushes to the organizer's lead portal; export available post-show as CSV. If you need direct HubSpot sync, we'll need to whitelist the domain and sign a data-sharing agreement.

Liz asked for a confirmed speaker list and session title by Fri 09/18 to lock the agenda. Also cc'ing the on-site logistics lead (onboarding email to follow) — we can set the 30-min sync for Tue 09/15 10:30 PT.

Liz Morales
Events Manager, ScaleAI Summit
liz@scaleai.org

--
Related link: https://app.docusign.com/partnership/LOI-2938

- Lead capture: ScaleAI QR -> organizer portal + nightly CSV export. We'll request HubSpot whitelist separately.

- Sergio: demo flow & landing page copy + asset pack (due 2026-09-20).
- Diego: send LOI to events + finance cost-share request (sent to finance; LOI in progress) (due 2026-09-16).
- Priya: confirm NimbleOps speaker & customer participant (due 2026-09-18).
